profile.headline: HL7 Integration Engineer
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with 7+ years of experience in healthcare, hospital industry, and technical support. Outgoing and detail oriented. Proficient in building and maintaining professional relationships with great communication skill. Have a Bachelor’s Degree in Information Science and Technology (IST).

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.locationName: King of Prussia, Pennsylvania, United States
positions.description:
•	Provide business and technical expertise for Cerner applications and OPENLink Interface Engine
•	Define and plan the project scope with the management and the clients Gather and analyze requirements by interacting with clients, vendors, end users, and the subject matter experts to fully understand project expectations
•	Provide analysis on vendor requirements to create new interfaces and modify existing interfaces
•	Engage in weekly meetings to discuss specification from various teams involved in the project
•	Migrate Cerner ADT interfaces from Invision EMR system to Cerner EMR system while providing HL7 interface related knowledge and technical support for all interfaces across the organization
•	Implement real time interfaces using OPENLink interface engine, performing mapping and testing
•	Work on HL7 inbound/outbound interfaces using OPENLink. Also managed various interface messages and triggers such as ADT, SIU, ORM, ORU, MDM, DFT and MFN.
•	Maintain, define, and validate data mapping, filters, templates, and connection channels for interfaces
•	Responsible for testing and participating in system and integration testing with help of various team within the organization
•	Collaborate with various teams on and off site to successfully deliver and implement new interfaces
•	Use various Cerner Applications to validate, code and Alias necessary code sets for the ancillary systems
•	Have experience on building many different types of HL7 interfaces including ADT, ORDERS, ORU, MDM, PHARMACY, RADIOLOGY, CARDIOLOGY, LAB etc.

positions.title: Technical Support Specialist
positions.description:
Assisted, analyzed, resolved, tracked, and where necessary escalated store system hardware and software incidents
Provided Tier 1, 2-telephone support in accordance with operating and service level agreements
Supported PC hardware components, desktop operating system software, application software and configured network where needed
Interacted with and respond promptly to end user requests and inquiries via telephone and email
Maintained and document reported user issues via trouble ticketing system
Provided end user support for various levels of technical and non-technical help desk support requests
Collaborated with other IT teams to identify best practices and solutions for troubleshooting
Used details to provide problem recognition, research, resolution and documentation
Used MYSQL data to investigate and resolve issue

positions.title: Computer Technician
positions.description:
Provide customer service in the service center and on-site to business and residential clients
Accurately document service activities & assist with administrative tasks in the service center
Troubleshoot computer problems; install hardware/software; maintain computer equipment.
Configure basic computer wired and wireless networks
Provide courteous and effective support to clients on-site or by phone, email, or remote connection
Work with third party vendors to facilitate services and solutions

projects.title: Hospital Database Application
projects.description:
Working in a group of four, design and develop a working windows application to use for hospital.
The application was developed using Oracle Database and C# windows form.
The application shall store and retrieve patients medical record, bill as well as general information about patient.

projects.title: Missile Defense
projects.description:
Working in group of four, we were to design and develope a Missile Defense application using C# windows form. 
The application shall fire missile at a incoming bogie and destroy the bogie using appropriate missile.
The application shall self destroy the missile if the user chooses to.
The application shall scan for incoming bogies.
